description.text:
The deck that won the Senior Division of the 2023 World Championships, built on the pairing of Lugia VSTAR and Archeops: Lugia VSTAR puts Archeops straight onto the Bench from the discard pile, and Archeops attaches Special Energy to power Lugia up at once for its Tempest Dive attack. The 2023 World Championships were held at Pacifico Yokohama in Yokohama from 11 to 13 August 2023, the first in Japan and in Asia; 348 players from 36 nations played the card game there.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2023 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a pin, a coin, a deck box, a playmat, a poster and a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
